secrets.name: AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible provider that powers the AI Lab tools (assistant, fashion studio, research explainer, concept explorer). Any provider exposing POST {AI_BASE_URL}/chat/completions works; set AI_BASE_URL/AI_MODEL in .env.base44-defaults to match. Without it the tools show an honest "not connected" state instead of answers.
